look.image: Clean, sharp, grain-free image with no digital noise; warm tungsten highlights against deep cool shadows; soft halation around warm lights; rich shadow detail, no crushed blacks.
look.light: Exteriors are desaturated slate-blue winter twilight; the bakery interior is warm golden-amber tungsten; warm light spills into the cold blue wherever a door or window opens.
look.lens: 50–85 mm prime look, shallow depth of field.
look.camera: Eye level, dropping to a 7-year-old's eye height for shots centred on the boy; faint handheld breathing only; no gimbal glides, orbits or zooms; framing changes only at the hard cuts written below.
look.atmosphere: Heavy snow falls slowly and steadily through every exterior frame, drifting and turning, never frozen in the air; breath fogs on every exhale outdoors.

avoid: subtitles, captions or any text except the wooden CLOSED sign and the crayon words "Merry Christmas, Mom"
faces, costumes or props changing between shots

baker.appearance: a man of about 58, oval weathered face, gentle hazel-brown eyes with crow's feet, rosy cheeks, neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, silver-grey hair combed back

A.label: apron
A.costume: a flour-dusted espresso-brown waxed canvas apron over a chestnut-brown shawl-collar cardigan, sleeves pushed to mid-forearm, charcoal wool trousers

B.label: overcoat
B.costume: a charcoal herringbone wool overcoat buttoned over the chestnut-brown cardigan, a slate-blue knit scarf, charcoal trousers, brown leather boots; no apron

baker.voice: warm, quiet, slightly gravelly baritone, unhurried

boy.appearance: a 7-year-old boy, heart-shaped face, large warm brown eyes, light freckles, wind-chapped rosy cheeks and nose, tousled chestnut hair
boy.costume: an oversized navy duffle coat with wooden toggles, a dark forest-green beanie pulled low, a red-and-navy tartan scarf, dark-charcoal knitted mittens dusted with snow
boy.voice: a small, earnest 7-year-old's voice, a little breathless from the cold

mother.appearance: a woman of about 32, slender oval face, pale skin, tired shadows under grey-blue eyes, dark ash-blonde hair in a loose low bun
mother.costume: a thin heather-grey wool coat, a long burgundy-and-oatmeal striped scarf wrapped twice, dark grey fingerless gloves

carrier.short: the cardboard carrier of three steaming paper cups

bakery.layout: Seen from the street: the glass-paned front door in the centre, the wooden sign hanging inside its glass; inside, the counter runs across the back of the shop; the small table set for one stands by the front window on the right
bakery.light: Warm tungsten from brass pendants inside; slate-blue twilight outside

square.layout: A wooden bench stands under the tall lit Christmas tree; the bakery's glowing windows face it across the snowy cobbles
square.light: Slate-blue twilight; warm golden bokeh from the tree's bulbs; snow lit by the cast-iron streetlamps
